items.content_html: PLAYGO is a lightweight, modular web-based IPTV player that connects to Xtream UI-compatible IPTV services. It does not redistribute or host any content; instead, it allows users to stream IPTV by configuring the provider's IP and port. PLAYGO is ideal for users who want a centralized and personalized IPTV experience.

items.content_html: Collaborative Canvas is a real-time web app that lets multiple users draw together on a shared canvas. Built with Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO, it syncs strokes instantly across clients. It supports brush tools, colors, and global undo/redo, using in-memory data for fast, smooth, and lightweight collaboration.
